# OpenAI client and API errors wrapped

Initialization errors from openai.OpenAI()/openai.AzureOpenAI() and OpenAI API errors from embeddings.create are caught and re-raised as LLMProviderError with descriptive messages.

Normalize external SDK errors into the compiler's LLMProviderError type for consistent error handling.

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/embeddings.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.embeddings.AzureOpenAIEmbedder.__init__`
